_comment: Pre-registered BEFORE any C3 number exists (2026-08-04, commit follows immediately). Baseline is P1 no-clip with the project's standard stratified grouped 5-fold CV, seed 0, refit per fold. Written now precisely because C2 showed how a small overall-AUROC gain can coexist with zero improvement on the errors the branch was built to fix -- C2-v2 moved the pooled AUROC +0.007 while the regrasp+direction_reversal false-positive rate stayed at exactly 2/27, and its rescues and harms were balanced 13/13 with 12 of the 13 harms being true boundaries destroyed. A gate that only reads pooled AUROC would have called that ambiguous instead of a failure.
_primary_comment: THE criterion, per the review's explicit instruction: of P1's false positives, how many does C3 rescue, and of P1's true positives, how many does it break? C3's value must show as motion false positives falling with few sharp true positives harmed -- not as C2's pattern of many rescues cancelled by equally many harms. Both counted at the SAME operating point (the median of P1's true-positive OOF scores) rather than each arm at its own median, so this is a real net-error change and not a rank-only comparison.
_worst_fold_comment: worst PER-FOLD delta, i.e. min_i(candidate_i - baseline_i), NOT min(candidate) - min(baseline). The latter is what three earlier gates in this repo computed; it is provably always >= the true worst per-fold delta, so it can only ever be too lenient. See gate_worstfold_recheck.py.
_same_action_comment: The coarse same_action_internal_motion false-positive rate must not exceed P1's current 2/27 = 0.074. Coarse, not per-subtype, because batch3's 116 negatives carry only the coarse label -- they came from blind review with no free-text notes, so same_action_subtype_v1.csv covers 37 of the merged set's 153 negatives (24%). A per-subtype criterion would silently be computed on the old, distribution-skewed quarter of the data only.
_ci_comment: 95% CI on the AUROC delta from a bootstrap resampling RECORDINGS, not events. The block probe scored +0.054 on the clean-145 with a CI excluding zero and then +0.007 on batch3; a CI alone does not survive arm selection, so this is necessary and not sufficient.
_detector_comment: A crop branch whose box misses the hand is measuring the detector, not the hypothesis. If the detection failure rate or the crop-contains-hand rate breaches these, the run is INVALID rather than negative -- it does not count as evidence against C3, and --detector none must be run as the control before anything is read into either arm.
evaluation_set: clean-145 first; the merged 313 (clean-145 + batch3, zero recording overlap, verified) once source-aware stratified folds exist
confirmatory_set: batch4, held out and unlabelled at the time of writing
_set_comment: batch4 did NOT exist when this was written -- no files, no sampling run, only the --exclude_manifest infrastructure. Merging batch3 into development spends the project's only labelled held-out set, so nothing here may be called confirmed until batch4 is sampled, labelled and run once.
